evals.prompt: I want to add order management to my Laravel app using Spatie event sourcing. Orders can be placed, have line items added, shipped, and cancelled — but only if not already shipped. I need a standard orders read model and daily revenue statistics. Ship confirmation should email the customer.
evals.expected_output: Gate 1: ADR with OrderAggregate, 4 commands, 4 events, 2 projectors (sync + queued), 1 reactor. Gate 2: Full code generation with passing tests.
expectations: An ADR file exists with sections for aggregates, commands, events, projectors, reactors
Events use past-tense domain names (OrderPlaced, LineItemAdded, OrderShipped, OrderCancelled)
ADR or code enforces 'cannot cancel shipped order'
Both a sync OrderProjector and a queued statistics projector exist
A reactor for sending ship/order confirmation email exists
Test files exist for aggregate, projector(s), and reactor
Files organized under app/Domain/Orders/
Command DTOs and handler classes exist
Read models extend Spatie\EventSourcing\Projections\Projection, not plain Eloquent Model
Projectors use writeable()->save() pattern, not updateOrCreate

evals.prompt: I have an existing users table with CRUD controllers. Can you refactor it to use Spatie event sourcing?
evals.expected_output: Polite refusal explaining that CRUD-to-ES refactoring is out of scope, with suggestion to design greenfield alongside existing code.
expectations: Response explicitly says CRUD-to-ES refactoring is out of scope
No PHP implementation files are produced
Suggests building greenfield alongside existing code

evals.prompt: I want to event-source my inventory tracking. Products can be received, sold, adjusted, and transferred between warehouses. I need a stock level projector.
evals.expected_output: The skill should run verify-setup.sh first. Since spatie/laravel-event-sourcing is not installed, it should stop and tell the user to install it — no ADR, no code generation.
expectations: Response mentions that spatie/laravel-event-sourcing is not installed or missing
Response provides the command to install it (composer require spatie/laravel-event-sourcing)
No ADR is produced
No PHP implementation files are generated
The skill does not proceed to Gate 1 domain questions

evals.prompt: I need a reservation system for a hotel. Guests can make reservations, check in, check out, and cancel. Cancellation after check-in should be refused. I need a room availability projector and a confirmation email reactor.
evals.expected_output: Gate 1: ADR with ReservationAggregate, 4 commands, 4 events, 1 sync projector, 1 reactor. Gate 2: Full code generation with passing tests.
expectations: An ADR file exists with sections for aggregates, commands, events, projectors, reactors
Events use past-tense domain names
ADR or code enforces 'cannot cancel after check-in'
A room availability projector exists
An email confirmation reactor exists
Test files exist for aggregate, projector, and reactor
Files organized under app/Domain/ (not flat app/Events/)
Command DTOs and handler classes exist
Read models extend Spatie\EventSourcing\Projections\Projection, not plain Eloquent Model
Projectors use writeable()->save() pattern, not updateOrCreate
